title: Survival Currency
description: A fair and survival friendly solution to currency.
body:
A fair and simple currency mod that adds a new item, "Golden Coin" crafted with a gold nugget. After it is crafted, the crafter's name is added into the name of the item in golden text. 

This adds value to the coin, it cant be counterfitted and inflation has to be intentional.
![A picture of the golden coin crafted by "Dev"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aee7a9261822d6ec74ee9782779a5f5832dafedb_0.webp)

This mod was made because many currency mods require admin input. I wanted to make one that was fully survival friendly.
